name: Litsea cubeba oil
description: Litsea cubeba oil (CAS 68855-99-2 ), also listed under FEMA 3846 , is a natural essential oil cold-pressed or steam-distilled from the fruit of the Litsea cubeba plant, native to East and Southeast Asia. It delivers a fresh, intense lemon-citrus character that makes it a sought-after ingredient in both flavor and fragrance applications. In food and beverage manufacturing, it functions as a natural flavoring agent. This oil is commonly used in confectionery, beverages, and baked goods where citrus profiles are required. Fragrance formulators use it as a cost-effective alternative to lemon or lemongrass oil in soaps and detergents. It is also a popular choice for personal care products including shampoos and body washes. Its antimicrobial activity supports use as a preservation component in cosmetic formulations targeting shelf-life extension. Pharmaceutical and nutraceutical manufacturers also incorporate it into topical preparations and oral care products. These applications typically require natural citrus-forward scent profiles for consumer appeal. The oil is supplied as a pale yellow to yellow mobile liquid. It is available in food-grade quality meeting the necessary standards, as well as cosmetic-grade and technical-grade variants for industrial use. Standard packaging ranges from small drums to bulk quantities to suit various production scales.
